transcript.text: Just had a new induction hob fitted, Beko. When I put my saucepan on it just flashes a U and doesn't heat. Is it faulty? It's brand new!!

Induction hobs only work with magnetic pans. A fridge magnet should stick firmly to the base of your cookware. Please try using a pan you know works on the other zones, ensuring it is centred on this specific zone. Does a known-good pan heat on this zone, or does it fail too?
Well my cast-iron casserole did heat on one of the zones, and a magnet sticks to that. But the magnet doesn't stick to my saucepans, and those just flash the U. Is that the problem?

[Heading: Pan not suiting induction]
Thanks for letting me know the symbol is still flashing. Based on what you’ve described, the most likely cause is that the pan isn’t suitable for induction cooking. I can’t confirm this from our current information, but induction hobs require pans with a flat, magnetic base large enough to cover the heating zone; a fridge magnet should stick firmly to it. If you find that a pan which works on another zone also fails on this one, please let me know.
